name: retold-content-system
description: Retold Content System - Markdown content viewer and editor

scripts.build: npx quack build && npx quack copy
scripts.build-all: npm run build-codemirror && npm run build-codejar && npm run build

retoldBeacon.description: Markdown content viewer + editor server; serves a content folder over HTTP and registers as a beacon.

Fields.Name: HostContentPath
Fields.Label: Host markdown folder to serve
Fields.Help: Absolute path on the host whose markdown contents will be served; bind-mounted read-only into the container at /app/content.

author: steven velozo <steven@velozo.com>

brand.Name: Retold Content
brand.Tagline: Author content for the Retold ecosystem
